sale_payments_card_check.name: sale_payments_card_check
sale_payments_card_check.value:
("sale_payments"."card_id" is null and "sale_payments"."installments" is null and "sale_payments"."surcharge_pct" is null and "sale_payments"."surcharge_amount" is null)
        or ("sale_payments"."type"::text = 'credito' and "sale_payments"."card_id" is not null and "sale_payments"."installments" is not null and "sale_payments"."surcharge_pct" is not null and "sale_payments"."surcharge_amount" is not null
          and "sale_payments"."installments" in (1, 3, 6, 12) and "sale_payments"."surcharge_pct" >= 0 and "sale_payments"."surcharge_amount" >= 0)

menu_items_prices_check.name: menu_items_prices_check
menu_items_prices_check.value:
case
        when "menu_items"."menu_group" in ('empanadas', 'sanguches')
          then ("menu_items"."price_1" is null and "menu_items"."price_3" is null and "menu_items"."price_6" is null and "menu_items"."price_12" is null)
            or (coalesce("menu_items"."price_1", 0) > 0 and coalesce("menu_items"."price_3", 0) > 0 and coalesce("menu_items"."price_6", 0) > 0 and coalesce("menu_items"."price_12", 0) > 0)
        else ("menu_items"."price_1" is null or "menu_items"."price_1" > 0) and "menu_items"."price_3" is null and "menu_items"."price_6" is null and "menu_items"."price_12" is null end

menu_items_base_check.name: menu_items_base_check
menu_items_base_check.value:
not "menu_items"."is_base" or ("menu_items"."unit_cost" is null and "menu_items"."price_1" is null and "menu_items"."price_3" is null and "menu_items"."price_6" is null and "menu_items"."price_12" is null
        and "menu_items"."menu_group" in ('pizzas', 'ciabattas') and "menu_items"."stock" = trunc("menu_items"."stock"))

sale_lines_kind_check.name: sale_lines_kind_check
sale_lines_kind_check.value:
("sale_lines"."promotion_id" is null and "sale_lines"."menu_group" is not null and "sale_lines"."presentation_key" is not null)
        or ("sale_lines"."promotion_id" is not null and "sale_lines"."menu_group" is null and "sale_lines"."presentation_key" is null)

promotion_components_presentation_check.name: promotion_components_presentation_check
promotion_components_presentation_check.value:
case
        when "promotion_components"."menu_group" in ('empanadas', 'sanguches') then "promotion_components"."presentation_key" in ('u1', 'u3', 'u6', 'u12')
        when "promotion_components"."menu_group" = 'pizzas' then "promotion_components"."presentation_key" in ('pizza_1', 'pizza_2')
        else "promotion_components"."presentation_key" = 'u1' end
